title: Gossip Protocol Abuse Anza Technical Report 2026
text:
Gossip Protocol Abuse on Solana - Anza Technical Report 2026

Gossip protocol vulnerabilities:
- CrdsData flooding: send excessive gossip entries to exhaust CPU
- Fake peer injection: advertise non-existent validators
- Stale data poisoning: broadcast outdated contact info
- Bandwidth exhaustion via gossip amplification

Protocol details:
- Solana gossip runs on UDP port 8001
- Each validator maintains CrdsTable of network state
- Push/Pull messages propagate data to all peers
- No rate limiting on gossip message ingestion

Attack scenarios:
- Flood gossip with invalid signatures to exhaust verification CPU
- Inject fake validator entries to pollute routing tables
- Partition network by advertising wrong contact info for validators
- Amplify gossip by triggering pull responses from many peers

Detection:
- gossip_packet_rate > 10000/sec from single source
- CPU usage spike on gossip thread
- CrdsTable size growing unexpectedly
- Peer connection churn rate elevated

Mitigations:
- Gossip rate limiting per peer (implemented in v1.18)
- Signature verification caching
- Peer reputation scoring
- Gossip message deduplication
Source: Anza Technical Report 2026
